page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the weak category. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores enable average multi-core performance across several tests, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register in the average tier, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the weak single-core performance and average multi-core capabilities, this instance is suited for parallelizable workloads that can leverage the 32 dedicated cores rather than single-threaded speed. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and database operations, which achieved average tier results in benchmarks. It is less suitable for single-threaded compression tasks or memory-latency-sensitive applications due to lower single-core and memory benchmark scores.
